semiconductor_relevance: High — U-Precision Tech Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing equipment and systems for IC manufacturing and precision applications.
summary: U-Precision Tech Co., Ltd. provides advanced equipment and ultra-precision motion systems tailored for the semiconductor industry, particularly in IC manufacturing and testing. The company focuses on delivering high-end manufacturing solutions and custom services, leveraging technology developed in collaboration with top universities.

regional_presence.China: The company operates primarily in China, focusing on both domestic and international markets.
